name: [OpenPaw] Error Rate Spike
message:
OpenPaw error logs exceed 10% of Cedar-authorized runtime traffic over the last 15 minutes.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [OpenPaw] Request Latency Spike (P95)
message:
OpenPaw p95 dispatch latency exceeds 5 seconds over the last 15 minutes.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] APM Request Rate Missing
message:
No APM HTTP request traffic for service:temperpaw in 15 minutes. This is the standard Datadog service-coverage rate monitor; use the Temper No Traffic monitor and Railway /readyz for corroboration.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] APM HTTP 5xx Spike
message:
APM HTTP 5xx responses for service:temperpaw exceeded 5 in 15 minutes. Inspect APM resources and logs before treating custom runtime counters as the only error source.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] APM HTTP Duration p95 Regression
message:
APM HTTP p95 duration excluding long-lived stream endpoints exceeded 2 seconds. Use this as the standard service latency gate; use Temper dispatch/blob/session/projection monitors to find the cause.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] WASM Invocation Duration p95 Regression
message:
WASM invocation p95 is above 5s for at least one trigger action. Check module execution, host calls, epoch drift, and integration timeout fallbacks before optimizing callers.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] WASM Host HTTP Duration p95 Regression
message:
WASM host HTTP p95 is above 5s. Separate remote dependency latency from guest execution before changing actor or projection code.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [OpenPaw] No Traffic
message:
No Cedar-authorized OpenPaw runtime traffic observed in 15 minutes. Platform may be down or request admission may be blocked.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Active Entities Drop
message:
Active entity count dropped below 1 for 10 minutes. Either platform is idle or the actor registry has lost state.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Indexed Entities Drop
message:
No indexed entities in OpenPaw's query plane. Platform may have lost discoverable state.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Startup Time Regression
message:
OpenPaw startup time to healthy exceeds 120s over the last 15 minutes.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] OS App Reconcile Regression
message:
OpenPaw OS app reconcile exceeds 60s during startup.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Required WASM Load Failures
message:
Required OpenPaw WASM modules failed to load in the last 15 minutes.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Session Memory Budget Exceeded
message:
OpenPaw sessions exceeded the bounded context memory budget in the last 15 minutes.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Dispatch Retry Budget Exhausted
message:
Dispatch retry budget exhausted (ADR-0048) — sustained transient failures indicate mailbox saturation or a stuck actor.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Permanent Actor Failures
message:
Permanent actor failures elevated — check for panics, init failures, or restart-exceeded conditions.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Mailbox Saturation (mailbox_full spike)
message:
Actor mailboxes refusing messages — tune admission control caps (ADR-0051) or investigate head-of-line blocking.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Abnormal State Timeout Firing
message:
State timeout firing unusually often for one or more (entity_type, state) combos. Likely causes: after_seconds too tight, or sessions are genuinely stuck.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Excessive Overdue Timers on Replay
message:
Many scheduled-action timers missed their deadline across a server restart window. Review deploy cadence or investigate replay lag.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Spec Liveness Violation
message:
A spec was loaded with uncovered non-terminal states (ADR-0050). Production should never boot with violations once TEMPER_LIVENESS_ENFORCE=true — investigate immediately.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Admission Deferred Spike
message:
Admission control is returning 503 Deferred to callers. Investigate: either bump the cap via /_admin/admission/ or diagnose sustained overload.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Admission Wait p99 Regression
message:
P99 admission queue wait exceeds 5s — caps likely too tight relative to offered load.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Mailbox Near Capacity
message:
One or more entity-type mailboxes are averaging above 80% capacity. Head-of-line blocking risk — tune admission caps (ADR-0051).

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Unexpected Mailbox Drops (post-P4)
message:
Mailbox-full drops are occurring even with admission control in place. Caps may be set above safe concurrency — reduce, or investigate slow actor consumers.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] WASM Default Timeout Fallback Rate
message:
Many WASM integrations are falling back to the default timeout. Wire `timeout_secs` explicitly in the integration configs. See ADR-0045 / ADR-0054.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Session Memory Externalization Spike
message:
Large session content is being externalized to blob storage at an unusual rate. Agents may be producing unexpectedly large responses — check for tool-call loops or runaway summaries.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Blob I/O Wait p95 Regression
message:
Blob I/O wait p95 is above 1s. Check whether large session content, file reads, or overflow field writes are moving critical-path work through the blob layer.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Blob Transport Wait p95 Regression
message:
Remote blob transport wait p95 is above 1.5s. Check backend/object-store health and whether the control plane is depending on remote blob round trips.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Monty REPL Wait p95 Regression
message:
Monty REPL wait p95 is above 1s. This points to tool execution queueing or too-low process concurrency, not necessarily actor runtime latency.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Session Context Prepare p95 Regression
message:
Session context preparation p95 is above 2s. Inspect loaded entries, content files, token/byte volume, and blob externalization before tuning the provider path.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Session Phase Duration p95 Regression
message:
At least one session phase has p95 duration above 5s. Use the phase/result tags to separate prompt/context/provider/tool-call work from runtime dispatch latency.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Admission Queue Depth Sustained High
message:
One or more admission queues are holding more than 50 waiters on average for 15 minutes. Tune the cap via PATCH /_admin/admission/{tenant}/{entity_type} or investigate sustained overload.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Dispatch Retry Attempts p95 Elevated
message:
p95 dispatch attempts exceeds 2 — system-wide transient contention is costing retry budget. Check mailbox saturation and actor cold-start latency before it escalates to exhausted.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Actor Registry Lock Contention (cold-start p95)
message:
Cold-start registry lock p95 exceeds 500ms for one or more entity types. Direct signal for temper#146 investigation — capture a CPU profile via /_admin/profile/cpu during the next burst and check for mutex contention.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Cold-Start Duration Regression
message:
Actor cold-start p99 exceeds 5s — freshly spawned actors are not ready to serve within the P1 retry budget. Root cause of the 2026-04-18 File dispatch exhaustions if this alerts. See temper#146.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] State Timeout Reset Rate Drop
message:
State timeout resets on Executing dropped to zero — the reset_on contract is not firing. Regression signal: the 2026-04-18 Katagami incident surfaced when monty_repl stopped emitting CheckpointToolBatch. Verify progress signals are reaching StateTimeoutTracker.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Cedar Evaluation Duration p99 Regression
message:
p99 Cedar eval exceeds 50ms on the ADR-0084 millisecond metric. If this monitor is No Data while traffic exists, enable Datadog percentile aggregations for temper_cedar_evaluation_duration_ms before treating the gate as live.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Event Store Append p99 Regression
message:
Event-store append p99 exceeds 1s. If this fires on the same replica as an Actor Cold-Start Duration spike, writer-lock or fsync serialization is the bottleneck.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Handler Deadline Breach Rate (W3 reserved)
message:
Handler deadlines breached at >5 / 10m. Check the `dying_span` breakdown on the Handler Liveness dashboard to identify which host function is the hang source. Awaits temper#147 primitive.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Epoch Ticker Drift (W3 reserved)
message:
Wasmtime epoch-interruption ticker p99 drift exceeds 100ms. Deadlines become imprecise when drift grows. Awaits temper#147 primitive.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Slow Handler Kill (W3 reserved)
message:
p99 time between deadline breach and guest exit exceeds 1s — guest code is resisting termination. Awaits temper#147 primitive.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Log Error Rate Spike
message:
Temper error-level logs exceed 50 / 10m. Group by @error.kind on the Log Explorer to find the dominant failure mode.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Panics in logs
message:
Temper panic or BUG message detected. Page on-call immediately.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [OpenPaw] Webhook Receive Errors
message:
Webhook-tier errors elevated. Investigate trigger bridges (Slack / Discord / HTTP).

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Profiler Upload Failures
message:
Continuous Profiler upload errors exceed 5/15m.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Profiler Uploads Stalled
message:
No Continuous Profiler uploads seen in 30m.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Integration Silent Exit (ADR-0056)
message:
A WASM integration returned without causing a state transition on its triggering entity. Under healthy operation this counter is permanently zero; any nonzero reading means one of the silent-exit preventions regressed:

- openpaw ADR-0039 Sub-Decision 3a (monty_repl structural invariant)
- ADR-0056 Sub-Decision 2 (Turso persist retry)

Investigate the entity/action/state tags on the fired event, correlate with `temper_turso_write_retries_total{outcome:exhausted}` around the same window, and check llm_caller / monty_repl logs for the offending session.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Hydration Re-arm Overdue Spike
message:
Hydration re-arm (ADR-0056 Sub-Decision 1) fired `on_timeout` immediately on more than 20 entities in 10 min. A modest burst is normal on deploy (actors hydrating into stale states), but a sustained spike indicates a wave of orphaned entities. Check `temper_state_timeout_fired_total{action:TimeoutFail}` for the downstream TimeoutFails, and inspect the affected entity_type tags.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Turso Write Retry Exhaustion
message:
A Turso write exhausted all retry attempts (ADR-0056 Sub-Decision 2). The calling entity's action failed via `on_failure`. If this fires repeatedly, Turso is in sustained trouble — check turso.tech dashboard for quota / region incidents.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [OpenPaw] Session Phase Budget Exceeded
message:
A fresh agent session phase exceeded its local budget before the state timeout fired. Inspect `phase` and `last_step` tags, then open the corresponding trace for the session.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Query Projection Update Errors
message:
Background query-plane projection maintenance failed. Entity transitions are no longer blocked by projection writes, so this monitor is the safety rail for projection lag or data-plane errors.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Query Projection Shadow Drift
message:
Catalog fast-read shadow checks detected projection drift against authoritative actor state. Treat this as a correctness incident before increasing projection read traffic.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Query Projection Shadow Check Errors
message:
Projection shadow checks are failing before they can compare catalog rows with actor state. Investigate actor hydration, read support errors, or catalog availability before trusting shadow coverage.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Query Projection Queue Wait p95 Regression
message:
Background projection updates are waiting too long before execution. This points to queue pressure, executor starvation, or projection write contention.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Query Projection E2E p99 Regression
message:
End-to-end query projection maintenance is above the latency budget. Compare queue wait, write duration, and Postgres transaction widgets to locate the bottleneck.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Query Projection Backfill Failures
message:
Projection backfill hit at least one entity-level error. Check the backfill coverage widgets before enabling projection-dependent read paths for the affected entity type.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Query Projection Replay Parity Drift
message:
Replay parity verification found durable projection drift against state rebuilt from the event journal. Pause projection-dependent optimization or fast-read rollout for the affected entity type until repaired.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Query Projection Replay Parity Errors
message:
Replay parity verification could not compare one or more persisted entities. Check catalog availability, transition-table registration, and event-store reads before trusting projection correctness.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Postgres Pool Acquire p95 Regression
message:
Postgres pool acquisition is consuming the latency budget. Check connection pool saturation, DBM wait events, and deployment concurrency before tuning query code.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Postgres Transaction p99 Regression
message:
Postgres transaction duration is above the p99 budget. Use DBM plan samples, app-side begin/commit timers, and projection write metrics to separate lock, network, and query execution causes.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Trace Sampler Metrics Missing
message:
Trace budget sampler configuration metrics are missing for OpenPaw. The ADR-0083 trace-volume policy may not be deployed, OTEL metrics may be blocked, or the service may be exporting with different tags.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Trace Sampler Delegated Volume Spike
message:
Trace sampler delegated more than 100k non-reduced spans in 15 minutes. Check whether a new high-fanout path lacks a reduced-prefix rule before relying on raw trace volume for diagnosis.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Dispatch Background Trace Budget Disabled
message:
Dispatch background trace sampling is effectively disabled. This can be intentional during an incident, but it re-opens the routine 100k-span trace risk from fanout-heavy projection or background dispatch work.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Cedar Evaluation Duration Max Regression
message:
Max Cedar eval duration exceeded 250ms on the ADR-0084 millisecond metric. Use the AuthZ Phase Breakdown dashboard to identify whether time is in request construction or Cedar authorizer evaluation.

@slack-openpaw-alerts

name: [Temper] Cedar AuthZ Phase Error
message:
Cedar AuthZ phase instrumentation recorded an error-path authorization attempt. Group by phase on the AuthZ Phase Breakdown dashboard, then inspect action/resource/principal validation errors in service logs.

@slack-openpaw-alerts
